children: Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) today announced the appointment of Yaron Ben David as Chief Technology and AI Officer, effective September 15, 2026. Ben David will report directly to President and Chief Executive Officer Jon Nudi and serve as a member of Masco’s Executive Committee.

The newly created role reflects Masco’s continued investment in the capabilities that support growth, innovation, and value creation across its portfolio of industry-leading brands. As technology, data optimization and artificial intelligence become increasingly important to serving customers, unlocking productivity and strengthening competitive advantage, Masco is building on the capabilities that help its businesses innovate, operate effectively and win in their markets.

By bringing enterprise technology, data and AI together under a dedicated Executive Committee leader, the Company strengthens its ability to scale innovation, accelerate capability building, unlock productivity and create greater value across its portfolio of industry-leading brands.

“Yaron is an accomplished leader with a strong track record of helping businesses harness technology, data and artificial intelligence to deliver meaningful business outcomes,” said Jon Nudi, President and Chief Executive Officer, Masco Corporation. “His experience leading complex transformations, building high-performing organizations and translating innovation into value creation makes him an excellent addition to our Executive Committee as we continue investing in the capabilities that support our growth strategy.”

Ben David brings more than 20 years of leadership experience spanning technology, artificial intelligence, large-scale enterprise transformation, and cybersecurity. He joins Masco from Standard Industries, a global industrial company with approximately $11 billion in annual revenue whose portfolio includes GAF, North America’s leading roofing and waterproofing manufacturer, and W. R. Grace, a leading global supplier of specialty chemicals and materials. As Standard Industries’ Chief Digital Officer, Ben David led enterprise-wide AI, data, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives across multiple operating companies.

Prior to joining Standard Industries, Ben David had extensive leadership experience serving with the Israel Defense Forces, including senior leadership positions within Unit 8200, the Israel Defense Forces’ intelligence and cyber organization, where technical expertise, advanced computing and innovation are applied to complex intelligence and cybersecurity challenges. In his leadership roles, he led major digital transformation, AI, cloud and data modernization initiatives. Throughout his career, he has built high-performing organizations and applied emerging technologies to solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable outcomes.

“Masco has an exceptional portfolio of industry-leading brands and a strong foundation for future growth,” said Ben David. “I am excited to partner with Jon, the Executive Committee and teams across the organization to further strengthen our technology, data and AI capabilities, accelerate innovation and help Masco’s businesses create value and win in the marketplace.”

Headquartered in Livonia, Michigan, Masco Corporation is a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of branded home improvement and building products. Our portfolio of industry-leading brands includes Behr® paint; Delta® and hansgrohe® faucets, bath and shower fixtures; Liberty® branded decorative and functional hardware; and HotSpring® spas.
